value_policy.rationale: The integrated baseline 5e84ca928dee is the control. Target >60% metadata RAM savings on fragmented swap and elimination of synchronize_rcu() stalls with all 17 correctness gates passing.

selected_idea.bottleneck: Upstream xswap uses a flat VM_SPARSE vmalloc array bounded by a single nr_clusters_mapped scalar, restricting reclamation to contiguous tail clusters and causing massive metadata memory plateaus when interior holes form. Furthermore, tail reclamation blocks synchronously in synchronize_rcu().
selected_idea.mechanism: Replace flat VM_SPARSE array with a 2-level RCU radix chunk directory. Each leaf chunk holds 64 swap_cluster_info descriptors and tracks active cluster count. When all clusters in a chunk are freed, the chunk pointer is atomically unhooked via xchg() and freed asynchronously via kfree_rcu(), reclaiming arbitrary interior holes without tail dependence and without synchronize_rcu() stalls.
selected_idea.expected_benefit: Eliminates metadata retention plateaus under sparse/fragmented swap, slashing attributable metadata memory by >60% on metadata-brd, while eliminating 10-50ms synchronize_rcu() stalls on shrink.
selected_idea.simpler_alternative: Retain flat VM_SPARSE array with tail-only scanning as in baseline.
selected_idea.falsifier: Reject on RCU UAF panic, memory leak under cluster churn, lock inversion between si->lock and ci->lock, failure of any of the 17 correctness gates, or latency regression on swapin.
required_evidence: Exact-tree independent source review including caller contracts
Fresh probe calibration under Protocol Revision 7 (or reference cache reuse)
selected_idea.no_upstream_reason: The relevant upstream implementation is already in the frozen baseline.
selected_idea.selection_reason: Replaces fragile VM_SPARSE tail unmapping with lockless 2-level RCU radix chunks to enable arbitrary interior hole reclamation and eliminate synchronous RCU stalls.

state.reason: Radix chunks map to same logical cluster indices.

lifetime.reason: kfree_rcu handles deferred chunk release safely without manual grace period management.

locking.reason: Cluster-level locks ci->lock and si->lock are retained.

error_paths.reason: Standard fallback on chunk allocation failure.

test_burden.reason: Requires verifying sparse hole formation and concurrent RCU chunk dereference.

interfaces.reason: Kernel swap cluster lookup interfaces swap_cluster_lookup_rcu() preserved.

memory_cost.reason: Unused interior chunks are freed to slab rather than remaining pinned in vmalloc.
